faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Senior Research Fellow position at NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Senior Research Fellow position at NIT Raipur is 09th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E./M.Tech./MCA or B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. with a valid GATE/NET score in relevant disciplines and meet the minimum aggregate marks or CGPA criteria.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 42,000/- along with House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q4. How will the selection process be conducted for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves submitting an application via Google Form, followed by document verification and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the NIT Raipur Senior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Senior Research Fellow announced by NIT Raipur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted online through the provided Google Form link.

faq.question: Q8. What is the minimum experience required for the Senior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: A minimum of two years of experience in a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is required.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Raipur located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Raipur is located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 492010.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are needed for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring the printed application, self-attested copies of DOB certificate, degree/provisional certificate, mark sheets, NET/GATE scorecard, caste certificate, NOC, and other relevant documents. Originals are also required for verification.
